verdict.rationale: Devin documents a general-purpose API for integrating it into applications and automating workflows, including creating sessions on behalf of any user in the org. The official MCP server exposes session management, playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling, and the llms.txt probe shows a large API documentation section. Nothing states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: explicit documented API/UI parity guarantee, evidence that UI features such as the embedded IDE takeover, Devin Review/Auto-Fix configuration, environment/blueprint setup, and org customization toggles are API-accessible, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration of API coverage.
